slides.text: Addis Standard reports residents near **Badme** describe **overnight bombardment** into **Nov 19**; claims are **not independently verified**.
**Eritrea's** government said on **Nov 18** that remarks by Ethiopia's army chief violate its **sovereignty**, Shabait reports.
Critical Threats reports a **UN and ambassadors' delegation** met **Tigray** interim leaders in **Mekelle** on **Nov 17**.

slides.title: Back tomorrow at 11 PM.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Sources: Addis Standard via AllAfrica, Shabait, Critical Threats · Nov 17-19, 2026
